Guess the winner 👀   Made these sweet potato + butternut squash fries for my toddler 🧡🍠   Such a great snack or easy side for babies + toddlers—and perfect for little hands! ✨ Ingredients: • 1 large sweet potato   • Top half of a butternut squash   • Olive oil   • Cinnamon   • 4 tbsp plain yogurt   • Carrot applesauce   • Avocado   • Garlic powder   Cut into finger-length pieces, toss with olive oil + a sprinkle of cinnamon, then bake at 350°F for ~45 mins (until soft and easily snap in half). ✨ Dips: • Plain yogurt + carrot applesauce   • Plain yogurt + avocado + garlic powder   My toddler loved dipping her fries..and her fingers 😭😭 #toddlerrecipes #toddlermealideas #easyrecipe #toddlersnack
